title: Fairness in Nursing Home Arbitration Act
short_title: Fairness in Nursing Home Arbitration Act

actions.text: Sponsor introductory remarks on measure. (CR S2819-2820)
Read twice and referred to the Committee on the Judiciary.
Committees on Aging. Joint hearings held with Committee on the Judiciary, Subcommittee on Antitrust, Competition Policy and Consumer Rights. Hearings printed: S.Hrg. 110-618.
Committee on the Judiciary. Ordered to be reported without amendment favorably.
Committee on the Judiciary. Reported by Senator Leahy without amendment. With written report No. 110-518. Minority views filed.
Placed on Senate Legislative Calendar under General Orders. Calendar No. 1109.

latest_action.text: Placed on Senate Legislative Calendar under General Orders. Calendar No. 1109.

summaries.text: Fairness in Nursing Home Arbitration Act - Provides that a pre-dispute arbitration agreement between a long-term care facility and a resident (or anyone acting on the resident's behalf) shall not be valid or specifically enforceable.

(This measure has not been amended since it was introduced. The summary of that version is repeated here.)
